query: How does Elasticsearch store dense vector embeddings for RAG?
notes: Dense vectors stored next to text fields in the same rag_chunks index.

query: What dimension and similarity should the dense_vector field use?
notes: Fixed dimension matching the embedding model, cosine similarity for ANN.

query: Can a single Elasticsearch index support both keyword and semantic recall without a separate vector database?
notes: Yes - one rag_chunks index supports BM25 and vector search.

query: Why keep BM25 text fields when also using vector search?
notes: BM25 finds exact API names, settings, error messages vectors smooth over.

query: When is lexical search stronger than semantic search?
notes: Lexical is strong for product names, config keys, exact exceptions.

query: Which exact-match terms is BM25 good at finding?
notes: xpack.security.enabled, dense_vector, pg_isready.

query: What local embedding model does this project use by default?
notes: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, produces normalized vectors.

query: How can BM25 and vector candidates be combined into one ranking?
notes: Reciprocal rank fusion or another transparent ranker.

query: When should you use semantic retrieval over keyword retrieval?
notes: Conceptual questions where the user's words differ from the docs.

query: What metadata should each indexed chunk carry for provenance?
notes: source URL, title, version, last updated, heading path, permissions.

query: How are stable chunk identifiers derived to make ingestion idempotent?
notes: Derived from source path, heading path, and chunk index.

query: Why store version and last_updated as keyword fields?
notes: So retrieval code can filter or boost recent documentation.

query: How does re-ingesting the same corpus avoid creating duplicate documents?
notes: Stable _id means the bulk operation updates the same document.

query: How is Elasticsearch configured for local development in this project?
notes: Single node, security disabled, memory limit, Docker Compose.

query: What does PostgreSQL store in this project?
notes: Application data: conversations, evaluation runs, audit records.

query: What does the /health endpoint check?
notes: Postgres connectivity (and ES) before later phases add persistence.

query: Why are retrieval and generation kept as separate importable modules?
notes: So they can later be exposed through LangGraph and MCP tools.

query: Why use a memory limit for the Elasticsearch container in local development?
notes: Memory limit keeps indexing/search behavior predictable on dev machines.

query: How do I configure Pinecone serverless indexes for production?
notes: Off-corpus: project uses Elasticsearch only, no Pinecone.

query: What is the best recipe for a chocolate fudge cake?
notes: Off-corpus: unrelated to the documentation.

query: How do I set up Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling for the API?
notes: Off-corpus: not covered by the sample corpus.
